decoder_attention_interfaces.method: pinned HF and local source AST/signature inspection

unit_tests.skip_reason: Original-source numerical differential requires explicit --source-root; it passed separately in the 15-case CPU CLI run.
unit_tests.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

findings.trigger: Run two prompts of different sequence lengths in one model process, with the default SparseMM ratio budget.
findings.result: The second prefill uses head_adaptive_capacity computed from the first prompt length. If the first prompt is shorter, the second is over-compressed relative to configured ratio. No first-prompt blocker is implied.

origin.artifact_pair: Already present when artifact qwen2_model.py and artifact baseline_utils.py are used together: qwen2 attention calls init_sparsemm without rebuild_cluster, while the common helper only creates a missing cluster.
origin.opensource_pair: The opensource LLaVA attention calls init_sparsemm only on prefill; its helper unconditionally creates SparseMM. That pair recomputes prompt-specific capacity each prefill.
origin.migration_assessment: The chosen artifact files preserve this artifact interaction. Relative to the old executable opensource LLaVA route, selecting the artifact pair is a migration-composition regression. Per-file AST equality does not establish equivalence to the old executable baseline. SparseMM was not active in the supplied llava_ov_ratio.sh loop; it is an additionally exposed dispatcher branch.
origin.first_sample_scope: Not known to prevent the first supported video generation.

findings.trigger: prompt_length = n*ASYMKV_CHUNK_SIZE + 1; e.g. 513 or 1025 for the default chunk size 512.
findings.result: range(0,prompt_length-1,chunk_size) omits the final one-token chunk. Final logits are based on a prefix that excludes the last prompt token, and original_seen_tokens is one short. For prompt_length=1 the loop is empty; configured sink/budget constraints may raise before reaching it.

origin.note: The source explicitly documents the range as matching the released upstream driver. This is not introduced by package/kernel/naming transformations.

findings.trigger: Call the custom text model directly with input_ids, use_cache=True, past_key_values=None and inputs_embeds=None.
findings.result: AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'shape' at MAX_LEN = inputs_embeds.shape[1], before the later embedding lookup.

origin.normal_runner_impact: The standard outer multimodal model constructs inputs_embeds before invoking the text model, so the supported adapter generate path bypasses this failure.

findings.trigger: Invoke a mask-producing outer model forward with only inputs_embeds and input_ids=None.
findings.result: The forward signatures accept embeddings, but mask construction dereferences input_ids.device (and token positions), raising AttributeError before the embedding-only path can run.

origin.normal_runner_impact: Selected evaluation adapters pass input_ids and visual tensors; this boundary is not a blocker for the intended token-based video generation. The Qwen cross-attention path was reproduced with an isolated real AST; the analogous custom/LLaVA paths were inspected statically.
